g.text: When is Device registration ready? Only after the record is saved
[Valid record for this server and physical identity]
registration needed (Idle, verified transport, gap over)
same physical identifier every time; 10 s attempt budget
validate: Location base path and type, body identifier,
candidate Device id in memory only
write complete record (URL, identifier, Device id)
next attempt repeats only the save (same boot)
attempt failed; after the gap repeat the conditional POST
200 OK for the existing Device; validate and save as above
Failed attempt, never a fallback: 412 (multiple matches), unsupported conditional create, authentication,
configuration or trust failure latch DEVICE_REGISTRATION_FAILURE; never an unconditional POST, never a new identity.
Recovery: 60 s after the first failure, doubling (120, 240 s); the 4th failure leaves registration
unavailable until restart. After a restart with no saved record the conditional POST is repeated.
